arStrings.szText:
Gain {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} second.

Gaining a stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} increases the damage of your next Skill within {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds by {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c}, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} times.
